# ToolPick
> Needs-based AI tool finder. 82 tools, prices copied from official pricing pages; each tool has its own checked date (latest 2026-10-19). 'check site' means unverified.

## Categories
- [Video](https://toolpick-ai.vercel.app/best-ai-video-tools.html): best value Runway; free options CapCut, HeyGen, Synthesia
- [Writing](https://toolpick-ai.vercel.app/best-ai-writing-tools.html): best value Claude; free options ChatGPT, Google Gemini, Grammarly
- [Coding](https://toolpick-ai.vercel.app/best-ai-coding-tools.html): best value GitHub Copilot; free options GitHub Copilot, Windsurf, v0
- [Images](https://toolpick-ai.vercel.app/best-ai-images-tools.html): best value Leonardo; free options Leonardo, Krea, Ideogram
- [Audio](https://toolpick-ai.vercel.app/best-ai-audio-tools.html): best value ElevenLabs; free options ElevenLabs, Suno, Otter
- [Presentations](https://toolpick-ai.vercel.app/best-ai-presentations-tools.html): best value Pitch; free options Pitch, SlidesAI, Canva
- [AI Assistants](https://toolpick-ai.vercel.app/best-ai-assistants-tools.html): best value Le Chat (Mistral); free options ChatGPT, Claude, Google Gemini
- [Marketing & SEO](https://toolpick-ai.vercel.app/best-ai-marketing-tools.html): best value Buffer; free options Buffer
- [Research](https://toolpick-ai.vercel.app/best-ai-research-tools.html): best value Elicit; free options Consensus, Elicit, ResearchRabbit
- [Productivity & Meetings](https://toolpick-ai.vercel.app/best-ai-productivity-tools.html): best value Fireflies; free options Fireflies, Zapier, Superhuman
- [Chatbots & Agents](https://toolpick-ai.vercel.app/best-ai-agents-tools.html): best value Botpress; free options Botpress, Zapier Agents

- [AI Subscription Audit](https://toolpick-ai.vercel.app/my-ai-costs.html#audit): list tools you pay for, get keep/cancel/try-free-tier checklist with potential saving from verified data only, e.g. ?tools=elevenlabs:6:monthly,descript:16:monthly

## Help me choose
- [Help me choose wizard](https://toolpick-ai.vercel.app/help-me-choose.html): 5-step guided shortlist, e.g. ?category=audio&budget=10&billing=monthly&seats=1&free=any&annual=any

## Compare builder
- [Compare builder](https://toolpick-ai.vercel.app/compare-builder.html): pick any 2-3 tools, e.g. ?tools=elevenlabs,descript,heygen

## Cost calculator
- [Cost calculator](https://toolpick-ai.vercel.app/my-ai-costs.html#calculator): true monthly/yearly cost by tool or category, seats and billing period, from verified entry prices, e.g. ?tool=elevenlabs&seats=1&billing=monthly

## Browse all tools
- [Browse all tools directory](https://toolpick-ai.vercel.app/tools.html): filter all tools by category, free plan, verified price, billing and seat pricing, e.g. ?category=audio&free=yes&sort=price


## How we pick
- [How we pick](https://toolpick-ai.vercel.app/how-we-pick.html): every pick shows how it was picked (official pricing data, not hands-on tested), price on its checked date, price history, earn disclosure (no affiliate links) and one real limitation

## Real cost of AI video
- [Real cost of AI video](https://toolpick-ai.vercel.app/my-ai-costs.html#video): seconds of video per plan and $/minute for Runway, Pika, Luma from official credit rates; same model+resolution comparisons only, e.g. ?s=60&t=3

## Real cost of AI voice
- [Real cost of AI voice](https://toolpick-ai.vercel.app/my-ai-costs.html#voice): minutes of text-to-speech per plan and $/minute for ElevenLabs, Luma, Runway from official pricing pages; monthly billing, same-model ranking, e.g. ?m=60&t=2

## Renewal reminders
- [Renewal reminders](https://toolpick-ai.vercel.app/my-ai-costs.html#reminders): calendar (.ics) or Google Calendar reminders before each AI subscription renews, with checked price and same-job cheaper option, e.g. ?r=claude:m:2026-11-05:20

## My AI costs
- [My AI costs](https://toolpick-ai.vercel.app/my-ai-costs.html): one page with tabs for the subscription audit, watchlist, renewal reminders, cost calculator, and real cost of AI video and voice. Old URLs redirect to the matching #tab.

## Smart search (v45)
- [Finder](https://toolpick-ai.vercel.app/?q=voiceover%20under%20%2410): type a whole sentence. It reads the job, a budget ("under $10", "$120/year"), team size ("team of 5": per-seat totals only where the verified entry price is per seat), billing ("no annual plan"), "free", "cheap", and tool names: "cheaper than ChatGPT" (same main job, same billing, like-for-like tiers), "like ElevenLabs but free", "ChatGPT vs Claude" (links the full comparison). Shareable: https://toolpick-ai.vercel.app/?q=cheaper%20than%20ChatGPT
